notes: Parent stated as Armstrong Air Conditioning, Inc., part of the Allied Air Division of Lennox. Page lists related brands AirEase, AirEase-Johnson, Aire-Flo, Allied Commercial, Armstrong, Armstrong Air, Concord, Ducane, Lennox, Magic-PAK, but no shared-system claim is made for them. Only style-1 year is shipped: month is the 5th-position letter whose chart is image-only (ARMSTRONGAIR1-HVAC-Age.png) and is not guessed; a later image pass can upgrade it to year+month. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: the second style (page example list Style 2: A14019E LA; the detail block mislabels it Style 1): month is the 7th-position letter and year is the 8th-position letter, both letter tables image-only (ARMSTRONGAIR2-HVAC-Age.png), so the entire style is image-only and no year field can be encoded.

styles.era: 10-character serials, 4 digits + letter + 5 digits (year only shipped)
styles.notes: Page positions 3-4 = year digits (1-based); the example's space is stripped by normalization. Month is the 5th-position letter, chart image-only, not shipped. Page example 4607 B20058.
